MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smaller digital caliper felt useful because I could check screw diameters and washer sizes when matching the small hardware I recently chose.",
    "Both calipers connected to my need to fit parts together accurately, though the smaller one suited my current small-part work better."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The SAE nut assortment looked related to my fastener purchases, but my recent screw set was metric, so I would not expect these nuts to fit it.",
    "Filament, temperature guns, heat shrink tubing and an inspection camera serve tasks I have not shown a need for; being workshop supplies does not make them useful to me now.",
    "Epoxy and super glue did not fit my current interest in removable fasteners and magnetic mounting, and I had no immediate bonding job."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any DIY tool or supply.",
    "The nut assortment seemed to match on being a fastener without enough attention to whether its sizing system matched my screws."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Metric sizing and compatibility matter when I am choosing parts to use with my recent screw assortment.",
    "My recent magnetic hooks and fasteners suggest practical mounting and part-fitting needs, rather than unrelated printing, wiring or temperature-measurement projects.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear immediate use; a relevant measuring tool is more compelling than supplies for a possible future task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small-hardware needs but stretched that interest too broadly across unrelated workshop tasks."
}
